label: Experiment 2 — microplastics at non-toxic concentrations with two insecticides
guideline: OECD 232 (Collembolan Reproduction Test in Soil) with modifications
soil: Lufa 2.2 natural standard soil (sandy loam; 1.66 ± 0.60 % organic carbon; WHC 44.2 ± 6.0 %; pH(CaCl2) 5.5 ± 0.1)
units: mg/kg dry soil (MPs in % w/w dry soil)
publication: van Loon et al. (2025) J. Hazard. Mater. 500:140493
caveats: MPs produced no fitted dose-response curve, so the EC50 used in mixture modelling is not measured: it is fixed at three times the NOEC (4 % w/w), i.e. 12 % w/w dry soil. The paper repeats the full analysis at 6 % and 24 % as a sensitivity check.
